summary: Frontend-only validation completed on the public preview URL across desktop/tablet/mobile. Most requested flows pass, but two critical issues were found: copy actions can crash the app when clipboard permission is denied, and desktop Home nav scroll behavior was inconsistent in repeated checks.

ui_bugs.issue: Home nav did not return to hero/top in repeated automation checks (scrollY remained ~1300-1600 after click).

integration_issues.issue: When clipboard write permission is denied, navigator.clipboard.writeText throws unhandled error and React runtime error overlay appears, blocking further interactions.

action_items: Wrap clipboard writes in try/catch and show non-crashing fallback toast/message when permission is denied.
Investigate desktop Home nav scroll handler reliability; ensure consistent scroll-to-hero behavior from lower sections.
Re-run full frontend regression after above fixes, including copy + navigation flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Unhandled async clipboard exception in copy() can surface as runtime overlay and break UX.
Critical user action (top Home nav) showed inconsistent behavior in repeated automated checks and needs deterministic handling.
seed_data_creation: Used browser localStorage only via UI submissions: synthlabs_beta_submissions, synthlabs_inquiry_submissions, synthlabs_support_submissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: A full run without triggering copy buttons passed tools/forms/modals/responsive checks. Triggering copy in this environment reproduced a runtime crash due clipboard permission denial. Avoid re-testing desktop-nav-home repeatedly without a code fix due loop-prevention threshold hit in this run.
rca of the issue: Clipboard bug RCA: copy() awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText without error handling. In environments where clipboard write permission is denied, a NotAllowedError is thrown and appears as uncaught runtime error overlay. Repro: open Tools -> click Prompt copy. Mitigation: guard with try/catch, optionally fallback to document.execCommand path, and always notify user without throwing. Home nav RCA (suspected): repeated automation clicks on desktop-nav-home from deeper sections did not move scroll position in checks; needs deterministic verification of click target and scroll trigger timing/behavior.
